title: AI Operations Coordinator
summary: Coordinates rollout of approved AI assistants across clinical support teams. Runs intake for new use cases, writes short how-to guides for staff, and tracks adoption. No clinical background required; training provided.
gap_bridging_angle: Six years running front-of-house scheduling for a 90-seat restaurant is the same job this posting describes: intake from people who do not know what they need, a written procedure they will actually follow, and a weekly number that says whether they followed it. The AI tools here are the ones you already use; the coordination is the part they are hiring for.
risk_factors: ["Asks for one year in a healthcare setting, and the posting does not say it is flexible.", "Hybrid three days a week in Manhattan, which the listing states as non-negotiable."]
description_text:
AI Operations Coordinator

Digital & Technology Partners is hiring an AI Operations Coordinator to support the safe, consistent use of approved AI assistants across our clinical support and administrative teams.

What you'll do
- Run intake for new AI use cases: gather what the team is trying to do, document it, and route it to the review group.
- Write short, plain-language how-to guides and run 30-minute training sessions for non-technical staff.
- Track adoption and produce a weekly summary for the Digital & Technology Partners leadership meeting.
- Maintain the internal register of approved tools and their allowed uses.

What we're looking for
- One year of coordination, operations, or administrative experience in any industry. Healthcare experience is helpful but not required.
- Comfort using tools like ChatGPT or Microsoft Copilot day to day. You do not need to have built anything.
- Clear written English; much of this role is writing things down so other people can follow them.
- We welcome applicants returning to work after a break and applicants changing careers.

Schedule: hybrid, three days per week on site in Manhattan.
Compensation: $62,000 - $78,000 annually, commensurate with experience.

Mount Sinai Health System is an equal opportunity employer.
